command: --test-name-pattern=claude: documentation marker works without Python or shell
red.result: Expected empty stderr and a created marker; actual Git Bash unavailable; hook skipped

green.skip: Windows file-symlink privilege unavailable; directory junction coverage passes

contract: Applicable documentation paths create a regular empty marker with no interpreter or child-process path
Write/Edit/MultiEdit, native backslashes, Unicode paths and normalized apply_patch moves covered across three launcher runtimes
Security-scan, staged Confluence and non-documentation paths excluded
Invalid input, unusable state directory and observed directory redirects degrade without failing edits
Existing nonempty files preserved with a diagnostic; empty regular marker reused without truncation
Legacy direct shell wrapper retained; registrations and generated interop remain current
limits: Full Linux CI and independent F2 review remain phase-level gates under T-19
The filesystem checks observe boundaries; they do not provide a sandbox against concurrent directory replacement
Measured launcher latency does not certify native client delivery
